newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Life plans to buy Y100 bln in bonds in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Life plans to buy Y100 bln in bonds in 97/98.

text.p: Tokyo Mutual Life Insurance Co plans to invest 100 billion yen in foreign and domestic bonds in fiscal year 1997/98, which started on April 1, a company official said on Tuesday.
The company held 18.5 billion yen worth of bad loans at the end of March, against total assets of 1.4685 trillion yen, he said.
He added that Tokyo Life's unrealised profits on its stock holdings would fall to zero if the Nikkei stock average fell to about 17,000.
